decisions.reason: Fouling detection automation is closely tied to the firm's heat exchanger expertise and supports digital service revenue, so it is likely kept while it builds market traction.
A web tool for weir dimensioning is cheap to maintain and serves as a lead-generation and customer-support asset, so there is little reason to remove it.
The fouling detection system is a hardware-plus-software offering that complements the core business, and such products are rarely dropped one year after launch.
